book_cn: 上外版选择性必修第四册
unit_cn: Unit 1 Achieving Effective Communication 实现有效交流
source: 上外版选择性必修四 Unit 1 词表(Reading A/B 真词 + Vocabulary Focus 主题表达);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、围绕公众演讲/交流主题、含目标词、不超纲为度;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Good communication can solve most of our daily problems.
words.example_cn: 良好的沟通能解决我们日常的大多数问题。

words.example_en: A good speaker keeps the audience interested from start to finish.
words.example_cn: 好的演讲者能让听众从头到尾都感兴趣。

words.example_en: The hall burst into applause when the speech ended.
words.example_cn: 演讲结束时大厅里爆发出掌声。

words.example_en: She had to deliver a speech in front of two hundred people.
words.example_cn: 她得在两百人面前发表演讲。

words.example_en: A speaker must convey ideas in a clear and natural way.
words.example_cn: 演讲者必须以清晰自然的方式传达观点。

words.example_en: Movement and questions help engage the listeners.
words.example_cn: 走动和提问有助于吸引听众参与。

words.example_en: He hid the manuscript under a flag where he could reach it.
words.example_cn: 他把讲稿藏在一面旗子下,以便随手取用。

words.example_en: Twain could still recall the night of his first lecture.
words.example_cn: 吐温仍能回忆起他第一次演讲的那个夜晚。

words.example_en: If you intend to be funny, add some humour where it fits.
words.example_cn: 如果你打算幽默一点,就在合适的地方加点风趣。

words.example_en: Nervous speakers sometimes bind themselves to a contract so they cannot escape.
words.example_cn: 紧张的演讲者有时用合同约束自己,这样就无法逃避。

words.example_en: The young lecturer made his first bow to the San Francisco crowd.
words.example_cn: 这位年轻的演讲者第一次向旧金山的观众鞠躬。

words.example_en: Somehow he managed to begin his talk without the notes.
words.example_cn: 他不知怎么设法没看讲稿就开始了演讲。

words.example_en: He placed a moving story in the middle of his speech.
words.example_cn: 他在演讲中间放了一个动人的故事。

words.meaning_cn: 可怜的;令人怜悯的;差劲的
words.example_en: The audience was touched by the pathetic part of the tale.
words.example_cn: 故事中令人怜悯的部分打动了听众。

words.example_en: After five minutes of agony, his stage fright finally left him.
words.example_cn: 经历了五分钟的煎熬后,他的怯场终于消失了。

words.example_en: Right in the middle of the talk he had placed a real gem.
words.example_cn: 就在演讲中间,他安排了一个真正的精彩之处。

words.example_en: He joked that his daughter's fine singing was hereditary.
words.example_cn: 他打趣说女儿动听的歌喉是遗传来的。

words.example_en: At first Helen spelled words in monkey-like imitation only.
words.example_cn: 起初海伦只是像猴子般机械地模仿拼写。

words.example_en: Helen kept confusing the words for mug and water.
words.example_cn: 海伦总是把'杯子'和'水'这两个词弄混。

words.example_en: A good speaker will seize the chance to win the audience early.
words.example_cn: 优秀的演讲者会抓住机会尽早赢得听众。

words.meaning_cn: 使铭记;给…留下深刻印象;使意识到
words.example_en: The teacher tried to impress on Helen that each thing has a name.
words.example_cn: 老师努力让海伦铭记:每样东西都有名字。

words.example_en: The same speaking rules apply to large and small audiences alike.
words.example_cn: 同样的演讲规则对大小听众都适用。

words.example_en: She finished her first talk with a deep sense of satisfaction.
words.example_cn: 她带着深深的满足感完成了第一次演讲。

words.example_en: Helen left the well-house eager to learn the name of everything.
words.example_cn: 海伦离开井房时,渴望学会一切事物的名字。

words.example_en: She felt a sudden thrill as the meaning of language came to her.
words.example_cn: 当语言的意义涌上心头时,她感到一阵突然的激动。

words.example_en: Louis Braille lost his sight as a small child.
words.example_cn: 路易·布莱叶在幼年时失去了视力。

words.example_en: Her whole attention was fixed on the motion of the fingers.
words.example_cn: 她的全部注意力都集中在手指的动作上。

words.example_en: A cool stream of water flowed over her open hand.
words.example_cn: 一股清凉的水流过她张开的手。

words.example_en: New words made the whole world blossom for the little girl.
words.example_cn: 新的词语让整个世界为这个小女孩绽放开来。

words.example_en: The teacher swept the broken pieces to one side of the room.
words.example_cn: 老师把破碎的碎片扫到房间一侧。

words.example_en: He would tuck his notes under the flag in case of need.
words.example_cn: 他会把笔记掖在旗子下面以备不时之需。

words.example_en: Miss Sullivan put a soft rag doll into the child's lap.
words.example_cn: 沙利文老师把一个软软的布娃娃放进孩子的腿上。

words.example_en: Helen soon learned a few verbs such as sit, stand and walk.
words.example_cn: 海伦很快学会了几个动词,如坐、站和走。

words.example_en: Her teacher placed her hand right under the running tap.
words.example_cn: 她的老师把她的手放在流水的水龙头下。

words.example_en: She felt a misty awareness of something long forgotten.
words.example_cn: 她感到一种对早已遗忘之物的模糊意识。

words.example_en: Speakers add meaning to their words with gestures and intonation.
words.example_cn: 演讲者用手势和语调为话语增添含义。

words.example_en: A warm intonation makes listeners feel you are talking to them.
words.example_cn: 亲切的语调让听众感到你在和他们交谈。

words.example_en: Stage fright is one common barrier to effective communication.
words.example_cn: 怯场是有效交流的一种常见障碍。

words.example_en: Fear of judgement is a psychological barrier many speakers face.
words.example_cn: 怕被评判是许多演讲者面临的一种心理障碍。

words.example_en: A good translation service can remove the language barrier between strangers.
words.example_cn: 好的翻译服务能消除陌生人之间的语言障碍。

words.example_en: With training and determination, Helen worked through every barrier.
words.example_cn: 凭借训练和决心,海伦克服了每一个障碍。

words.example_en: In a group you often need to compromise to reach one shared plan.
words.example_cn: 在小组里你常常需要妥协,以达成一个共同的方案。

words.example_en: A deep respect for differences helps us cross the cultural barrier.
words.example_cn: 对差异的深切尊重有助于我们跨越文化障碍。

words.example_en: "Distinguished guests and friends, it is a joy to be here," he began.
words.example_cn: “尊贵的来宾和朋友们,很高兴来到这里,”他开口说道。

words.example_en: Build your talk around offering the audience something genuine.
words.example_cn: 把你的演讲建立在为听众提供真实有价值的东西之上。

words.meaning_cn: 抵触的;有抵抗力的;抗…的
words.example_en: Listeners become resistant when a talk feels like a sales pitch.
words.example_cn: 当演讲听起来像推销时,听众就会产生抵触。

words.example_en: One way to beat anxiety is to be passionate about your topic.
words.example_cn: 战胜焦虑的一个办法就是对你的话题充满激情。

words.example_en: A skilled speaker can adjust a talk to cover almost any occasion.
words.example_cn: 熟练的演讲者能调整演讲以适应几乎任何场合。
